text: Bonegnasher the Petrifying is a basilisk located in Broken Shore.

Corporal Booraven was a Theramore soldier under Colonel Lorena. She was the rare case of a magic-sensitive human that could sniff out fel or arcane magic where the naked human eye couldn't. During the Third War, Booraven proved herself able to detect demons and even mortals possessed by the Burning Legion. Several Human Expedition generals also made use of her to find Jaina Proudmoore or any other Alliance wizard during the chaotic campaign. When Lorena received an order from Kristoff to lead Northwatch Hold's forces, Booraven was amongst those whom Lorena chose as her senior staff despite her lowly military rank. The truth was that Lorena did not go to Northwatch and instead went to search for Jaina, where Booraven's abilities shined. Lorena thus succeeded, and Booraven and the others returned to Theramore Isle. It is unknown whether she survived the destruction of Theramore.
Boprul is a drogbar and a member of Hardrogg's band who occasionally appears in the Stonedark Grotto in Highmountain. As his name suggest, Boprul beats on "Bop Rocks".

Precision is an Epic gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It grants the weapon infinite damage range, allowing for easier kills at longer ranges, but at the cost of a slower fire rate. It only appears on the NV4 - Flatline.variant.

__NOTOC__ Brack is a rare mob murloc found patrolling the Longshore coastline in Westfall together with Slark. He runs quickly, so catching him without pulling any of his murloc friends can be difficult. He is on a 2-3 hour respawn timer.
Brave Companion is the bravest corgi ghost ever located in the Temple of Humility in Bastion during Limbo (quest). He passes into the Shadowlands.
Brienna Nightfell is an Alliance shadow priest and is one of the possible opponents for Horde in the Faction Champions battle in the Trial of the Crusader raid instance.
Presence of Mind is a gun perk/weapon perk featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare as the former and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare as the latter.
Brighteye is a faerie dragon located at the Draakorium in , belonging to Fey-Guardian Baashia. He can be asked to sit (sits), play dead (feign death), or fetch (bring back a dead talbuk).
Brother Daniels is a human located at the Stair of Destiny in the Hellfire Peninsula. He is a priest praying for the wounded soldiers.
__NOTOC__ Bromithus is a green dragon located in the Late Night Lab in Thaldraszus.
The Point Knife is a melee weapon that was added to Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered in the August 8th, 2017 update.

Brother Sammuel is a human paladin and paladin trainer located in Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest. He can be found on the ground floor of the abbey, in the second room on the right from entering the building - in the hall of arms. He is notable for teaching novice paladins the basics of how to wield the Light. Following the death of Tirion Fordring, he joined the Silver Hand and is located in the Sanctum of Light. He later journeyed to Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore. When the Northshire Valley was attacked by the forces of Count Clessington, Sammuel defended the remaining soldiers and the wounded near the entrance to the valley.

Brother Paxton is a human quest giver located just northwest of the Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest. He is the caretaker of the Northshire library as well as a scribe. He makes ink for his scribing using his own recipe. One ingredient of this recipe is Rethban Ore, which he receives from Foreman Oslow in Lakeshire. He is currently keeping the Stormwind Infantry healed as they fight off worgs belonging to the invading Blackrock orcs. The soldiers do not seem very appreciative of his efforts. In Classic, he can be found in the library inside the abbey. When the Northshire Valley was attacked by the forces of Count Clessington, Paxton was seen healing an Injured Commoner near the entrance to the valley.
Bryanda is a succubus located at Grommash's Torment in . She summons a Victim and pushes them toward Shao'ghun.

Power Punch is an Epic gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It is exclusive to the Epic Nunchucks - Twin Dragons variant. It allows the weapon to have a chance to knock back an enemy upon killing them with the Nunchucks.

Bunnies are a race of humanoid rabbits who live on Bunny Island. The "good bunnies" are led by Funny Bunny (the Easter Bunny), while the "evil bunnies" led by Bunnylord have formed a gang to attack adventurers. Funny Bunny is capable of polymorphing humans into the bunny race as well.

__NOTOC__ Cailyn Paledoom is a blood elf demon hunter who can be found in various places on Mardum during the demon hunter starting experience. Years later, he was among those freed during the Burning Legion's assault on the Vault of the Wardens. He eventually made his way to Azsuna, where he left the Illidari and became a Felsworn after being tempted by Cordana Felsong.

Captain Placeholder was originally created purely as a temporary measure in the beta version of the game, allowing players to instantly teleport from Menethil Harbor to Auberdine, when some of the boat paths had yet to be implemented. His counterpart, Captain Noteo, would take travelers from Auberdine to Menethil Harbor.

Sergeant Pool is a character in Call of Duty: WWII. He is an M4 Sherman tank commander. In the mission "Collateral Damage", SSgt. Augustine Perez tells him and Abrams to hold position with the 2nd Platoon while Perez and Rabson go help the 1st Platoon, 1st Infantry Division. He and Abrams are not seen from that moment on.

Captain Bramblebeard is a human ghost located at Ironclad Cove in Deadmines. To reach the ghostly captain, Outlaw Rogues must bring their Parrot Cage (Green Wing Macaw) to the Ghostly Parrot below the tower. The captain was the leader of the crew that inhabited the cave before the Defias Brotherhood took over and killed him and his crew.
Caregiver Maximillian is a Maldraxxi necromancer located at the Wrangler Pit in Maldraxxus.

Caria Felsoul was a night elf demon hunter and one of Illidan's most cunning pupils. Though held in regard as one of the most cunning and adept demon hunters of the Illidari Caria would ultimately turn against them by joining the Burning Legion, enticed by their promises of power. Impressed by her skill, Kil'jaeden granted her the famous Aldrachi Warblades. During the Battle for the Broken Shore, Caria was summoned by to the Tomb of Sargeras. After Akama rejoined the Illidari, images of Caria and Varedis Felsoul appeared on the Fel Hammer and invited the demon hunters to join the Legion, though Varedis hoped they would refuse so he could kill them and get his warglaives back. The Illidari discovered that Caria and Varedis were on the Legion world of Niskara and invaded it with the Fel Hammer. With Kil'jaeden himself watching in amusement, Caria and Varedis were slain by their former comrades. Caria begged Kil'jaeden to save her as she died.

The Pommel of Barbarossa is a special tactical weapon that appears in the Call of Duty: WWII Nazi Zombies maps The Darkest Shore and The Tortured Path. It is a piece of the Sword of Barbarossa that was recovered by the MFAA team that was sent to Heligoland.

Cassandra Brennor is a human located at Tradewinds Market in Boralus. She co-runs the leatherworking shop Kul Tiran Skins and Leathers with her gruff partner Camilla Darksky. Boralus' guards refer to her as a wizard due to her skills.
__NOTOC__ Caretaker Ventraz is a red dragonspawn located in front of the Erupting Cavern in the Waking Shores. He is Life-Binding with a Ruby Culler.
Cedrik Prose is a human gryphon flight master located in Refuge Pointe in the Arathi Highlands.

Piercing Vision is a Tier 2 perk featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard. Piercing Vision briefly highlights enemies who are suppressed by gun fire, allowing players to see them behind walls and obstructions, unless that enemy is using Dauntless. Players who are being shot at by an enemy with Piercing Vision will see "SPOTTED" on their HUD. The distance from an enemy of where Piercing Vision can highlight them depends on the weapon class a player is using. For example, Light Machine Guns have a larger range, while Assault Rifles and Submachine Guns have a shorter range.

__NOTOC__ Cauldron Lord Malvinious was a skeleton found at Dalson's Tears in the Western Plaguelands. Despite his warrior-like appearance, he was a caster. Malvinious carried the key to the Dalson's Tears Scourge Cauldron.
Cecil Chiobrix is a Maldraxxi necromancer located by the Pool of Mixed Monstrosities at Plague Watch in Maldraxxus.

__NOTOC__ Cersei Dusksinger is a blood elf quest giver located at Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows. She can be found in the large building on the east side of the compound. She is a warlock and has a succubus minion.
Precise Shot is a weapon mod featured in the Battle Royale mode of Call of Duty: Mobile.

The Cenarion Scout is an unlucky night elf restoration druid captured by the Scourge and held within Acherus: The Ebon Hold. Lady Alistra, one of Acherus' death knight trainers, uses the unfortunate druid as an example of how the path of the unholy death knight can be used to combat those with powerful healing spells.
__NOTOC__ Cenarion Embassador Thunk is a tauren quest giver located at Thunk's Abode in Desolace. His flying mount, Thunk's Wyvern, sits nearby.
Centaur Outrunners are centaur creeps that can be encountered in the Barrens tileset.
The is a melee weapon featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6, and making a brief appearance in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4.
Cenarion Sparrowhawk was a hawk summoned by Cenarion Sparrowhawk Whistle in Terokkar Forest for The Raven Stones.
Ceron is a blue dragonspawn located at Algeth'era Court in Thaldraszus.
__NOTOC__ Chalsec of the Earth is a proto-dragon located in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

The is a vehicle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II. It is usable in the campaign mission Violence and Timing where several appear as part of the Al-Qatala convoy. It also appears as a prop in several multiplayer maps.
Charles Quall is a human ghost located in Westfall. He rides around, making his way to the Duskwood bridge, followed by his four ghost cows: Deebee, Keysha, Rowsie, and Tabula.
Chi Master Lim is a pandaren found in a house in Mandori Village on the Wandering Isle.
Chi-Ro the Skytamer is a pandaren flight master located at Huojin Landing on the Timeless Isle.

The Photonic Charge Barrel is a barrel attachment for the MORS Sniper Rifle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III as part of the Aftermarket Parts system. It was added as part of the Season Three update. This barrel allows the MORS to charge up before firing to increase damage and velocity, at the cost of lower velocity and damage values when uncharged. While it does deal increased damage when fully charged, it will not exceed its base velocity when fully charged.
__NOTOC__ Cinderwing is a felbat located on the Isle of the Watchers in Azsuna.
Cindy is an undead whelp and one of Wrathion's pets at the Celestial Tournament in Timeless Isle. It is presumably named after Sindragosa.
Clarence is a water elemental located at the Serene Dreams Spa in Thaldraszus.
The [https://www.polaris.com/en-us/off-road/rzr/models/rzr-pro-r/ Polaris RZR] is a vehicle featured in Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0, Call of Duty: Warzone Mobile, and Call of Duty: Black Ops 7.

Cloudrunner Leng is a riding trainer located on the Summer Terrace of the Shrine of Seven Stars in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. He is riding a jade cloud serpent. He is the primary trainer for the Alliance capable of teaching Wisdom of the Four Winds, which allows flying in Pandaria. The only other trainer that teaches the skill is Skydancer Shun, who is his counterpart at the Horde's Shrine of Two Moons. A version of Leng appears in the Vale of Eternal Twilight. He is located in Loamm in Zaralek Cavern with other members of the Riders of Azeroth.
__NOTOC__ Clokkistrasz is a red dragon located at the Ruby Lifeshrine in the Waking Shores. He is found talking to Zhustostrasza.
__NOTOC__ Coldtusk is a boar located in Shivering Trench in Frostfire Ridge.

The Pinpoint Holoscout is a holographic sight featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It is classed as a Universal Attachment and unlocking it for the weapon it is unlocked under, unlocks it for the entire weapon class. It is available for Assault Rifles, SMGs, LMGs and Marksman Rifles.

Commander Springvale is the third boss in Shadowfang Keep. By dungeon teleport, he is located in the Keep's chapel. Springvale was a paladin and the commander at the head of Baron Silverlaine's troops. He was killed with the other inhabitants of the keep by worgen, summoned by Archmage Arugal from the Emerald Dream to aid Gilneans against the Scourge. Since then, his ghost haunts the keep, using unholy strikes to avenge his lord. Years later, promising paladins and priests were sent to fight him and retrieve his holy symbol, in order to create a special weapon to honor their accomplishments.
Commander Hogarth is a human ghost located at the Expedition Armory in Hellfire Peninsula.
Commander Lethanak is a red drakonid located in the Waking Shores.
The is a melee weapon featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It was added on November 21st, 2024 as part of the Season One update.

, a ghostly cow.]] Cows are the most common type of large domesticated ungulates. They are specifically bred to produce large quantities of milk processed and sold for consumption. Pygmy cows were originally bred to make milk more palatable for gnomes.

__NOTOC__ The ghost of Councilman Stark I'ylar stands in the Ruins of Eldre'thar in Stonetalon Mountains. He and the other ghosts in the ruins seem to relive moments in their lives. I'ylar are seen talking to a crowd of Highborne Citizens.
Cousin Ich is a pandaren on the Wandering Isle that creates fireworks.

The [https://www.polaris.com/en-us/off-road/sportsman/models/sportsman-xp-1000/ Polaris Sportsman XP 1000] is a vehicle featured in Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0 and Call of Duty: Black Ops 7. The vehicle functions like the ATV with 3 seats.

Crafty the Ambitious is a 90 goblin in the Dark Heart of Pandaria scenario. Once he entered the Vault of Y'Shaarj, an echo of Y'Shaarj corrupted and possessed him, forcing the adventurers to kill him.

__NOTOC__ Crimper Mirjam is a human located in the Loose Cannnon in Boralus. She is the proprietor of the establishment and entertains her customers with her dancing and skills with the gun, when she occasionally shoots the Disgusting Rats scurrying around near the fireplace.
Credible Witnesses are blue dragonspawn located in the Seat of the Aspects in Valdrakken during Chaos and Commotion.
The Peacekeeper Mk1 is an assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7.

Cultist S'thara is a being that can be encountered as a boss in the single-player experience in the The Witchwood expansion for Hearthstone. Hagatha the Witch's dialogue indicates that S'thara has been tasked with converting the people of Gilneas into the witch's servants.
Cursed Mages are skeletal mages found wandering around in Plaguewood and Terrordale in the Eastern Plaguelands.
D'vorjakque was a wizard and the "Emperor Sorcerer" of many lands, for instance the Azure Glade, in the Warcraft III scenario called Azure Tower Defense.

The Power Armor is a type of personal infantry suit from the Fallout series. The Power Armor is featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 and Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0 during the Fallout event. In Black Ops 7, it appears as a Scorestreak within Endgame as a reward after completing the Deathclaw Hunt limited time World Event. In Warzone, Power Armor is featured within the Power Armor Royale limited time game mode, where players can access the Power Armor drop after fully filling their Fusion Core.

Cynthia Wallerby was a mage who, when using the spell Blink, accidentally got inserted into the side of a barn. A goblin shredder was used to remove her from said barn, but she lost a hand and a foot in the process. Her accident is chronicled in the book Blinking Rules & Regulations.
Dagnar Stonebrow is a dwarven death knight of the Knights of the Ebon Blade.

Dane Winslow is a human warlock located in Northshire Valley outside Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest. He can be found in the graveyard just south-east of Northshire Abbey, beside Drusilla La Salle. When the Northshire Valley was attacked by the forces of Count Clessington, Dane remained at his usual spot and was seen fighting two Clessington Attendants.

Power Armor Royale is a limited-time game mode featured in Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0. It was added on January 8th, 2026 as part of the Season One Reloaded update of Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 and remained in the game until January 22nd, 2026.

Dalar Dawnweaver is a Forsaken quest giver located at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. Dalar is a former archmage of the Kirin Tor, killed during the Scourge attack on Dalaran, raised as Scourge, and then freed by Sylvanas. It is only known that he was present when Kel'Thuzad was summoning Archimonde.
Dambala is a powerful and evil snake loa. He makes his first appearance in Ardenweald when he joined Mueh'zala's forces after being resurrected by his followers.

Dak'mal is an orc warlock. He is the master and companion to Umber Goonrock. After causing trouble on Kezan, he was sent by the goblins to Tol Barad inside the Fearsome Yacht in order to imprison him. In their way there, Dak'mal used magic to make a tribe of murlocs attack and wreck the ship. In the end though, a group of adventurers either killed or captured the orc, sending him back to Kezan and being rewarded for it.
The Pen Knife is a melee weapon featured in Call of Duty: WWII. It only appears in the campaign level Liberation.

Dalynnia Wrathscar was a mage and member of the Scryers. She gained the personal trust of , who sent her join the New Council of Tirisfal in Theramore Isle. After the Council shared their powers with the new Guardian, Med'an, Meryl Felstorm lost control of the dreadlord Kathra'natir. The demon followed the source of Med'an's power into the Twisting Nether, where he proceeded to drain all of Dalynnia's arcane magic. After sucking her dry, he tossed her body off the ledge.
Dampnet Ospreys are eagles located at the Windward Isle in the Jade Forest.

__NOTOC__ Daphne Stilwell is a human located on a small farm overlooking Westfall's Longshore, left of the Deadmines exit. Her husband is Jordan Stilwell and she is mainly seen picking apples off her trees. She used to live in Shadowfang Keep with Jordan, and together they helped the Church of the Holy Light greatly. The farm tends to go fairly unnoticed but it once had to be defended from the Defias Brotherhood by young paladins. Daphne herself proved to be a brave fighter who killed several of the attackers as well. The house is accessible by foot but is probably seen the most while on the flight path from Westfall to Stranglethorn Vale.
The Polaris Dagor A1 is a vehicle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 where it is available in the DMZ mode.

Darion Mograine is the leader of the Four Horsemen and the former Highlord of the Knights of the Ebon Blade. The son of Alexandros Mograine, one of the Highlords of the Knights of the Silver Hand and the original wielder of the Ashbringer, Darion was a paladin of the Silver Hand, and later of the Argent Dawn. After his father was murdered by his brother Renault Mograine, he came into possession of the :corrupted Ashbringer, and tried to save his father's souls inside. During the First Battle for Light's Hope, Darion used the sword to kill himself, destroying the Scourge forces and releasing his father's soul. Following the battle, the Archlich Kel'Thuzad raised him as an undead, while the Lich King made him the Highlord of Death Knights of Acherus and the ruler of Acherus: The Ebon Hold, once again wielding the corrupted Ashbringer. After defeating the Scarlet Crusade in the Scarlet Enclave, he and his fellow death knights broke free from the Lich King's control during the Battle for Light's Hope Chapel and founded the order of renegade death knights known as the Knights of the Ebon Blade. Under the leadership of Darion, the Ebon Blade spearheaded the attack against the Scourge alongside the Argent Crusade during the war against the Lich King, temporarily allied with them to form the Ashen Verdict and topple the Lich King. After Bolvar Fordragon became the Jailer of the Damned, Darion continued to lead his knights in keeping all of Azeroth safe, helping the Alliance and Horde
__NOTOC__ Danica Saint is a human flight master located at Light's Breach in Zul'Drak.

Darba the Crone is a Dark Iron dwarf warlock trainer located in the Forlorn Cavern in Ironforge. She is one of the Dark Iron dwarves that stayed with Moira Thaurissan after her reunion with the dwarves of Ironforge. She is found talking with Larn Caverndeep in Bonegrip's Runes and Dooms.

Plate Carriers may refer to: *Armor Satchel - An armor plate carrier featured in Call of Duty: Warzone, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II, Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0 and Call of Duty: Mobile, known as Heavy Plate Carrier in the latter. *Stealth Plate Carrier - A plate carrier in Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0. *Tempered Plate Carrier - A plate carrier in Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0 and Call of Duty: Mobile, known as Quick Plate Carrier in the latter. *Medic Plate Carrier - A plate carrier in Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0 and Call of Duty: Mobile. *Comms Plate Carrier - A plate carrier in Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0. *Recovery Plate Carrier - A plate carrier in Call of Duty: Mobile.

__NOTOC__ Dark Ranger Marrah is a Darkfallen dark ranger fighting against the vrykul in Northrend, located in the Utgarde Keep in Howling Fjord. She appears only for Horde groups, and runs up to the group inside the instance after the players enter and start moving towards the mobs for the first pull. She later attended a meeting between Dark Ranger Lyana, Sylvanas Windrunner, and a Horde champion as they discussed a mission to track down Varok Saurfang.
Dark Ranger Anya is a Darkfallen dark ranger who wanders the Undercity. She is one of the "Seeker" guards, which means she can see through Stealth effects.
Dark Ritualist Zakahn is a Neferset tol'vir located within Murkdeep Cavern in Uldum. He is protected by two Ritual Guardians. Years after his death in the Cataclysm, he returned as a ghost.

Phantom Blade of the Night (Synaptic - Gundam Deathscythe Hell "EW" Battle Theme) is the fifth track of the Call of Duty: Mobile Gundams Arrive Version (Original Game Soundtrack). It is composed by Tencent Games and [https://www.imdb.com/name/nm8906154 Kazuki Higashihara], with a runtime of 1:44.
__NOTOC__ The Dark Watcher is a kyrian located just outside the Citadel of Loyalty in Bastion. She can only be seen while dead. If you speak to her, she will restore you to life to do battle.
Darkhatched Sorcerer is a saurok in the Dagger in the Dark scenario.

__NOTOC__ Darkscryer Raastok is an arakkoa aligned with the Arakkoa Outcasts. He considers the Adherents of Rukhmar close-minded fools for forbidding the study of shadow magic and branding all who seek answers in the dark as heretics. As such he will accept help from anyone in saving the forbidden tomes of knowledge in Veil Shadar.

Punta Gorda (Spanish for Fat/Thick Point) is an M1128 Mobile Gun System that appears in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2. It appears in the mission "Team Player", and is part of a convoy of vehicles on the bridge. It then enters Tunnel Harvey with the Humvee 'Blue Steel' and disappears, apparently into a wall, as if the player gets out of the map using the glitch in the school playground, and then go up to that tunnel and go inside, it is a dead end.

__NOTOC__ Daughters of Cenarius are dryads found in the Stonetalon Mountains at Stonetalon Peak. They have a ranged attack (their spears) and they usually always cast Dispel Magic. Braelyn Firehand would like them killed.
__NOTOC__ Darnassus Mage is a night elf located in Kun-Lai Summit. She briefly appeared to teleport the :Divine Bell to Darnassus.
Darrowshire Betrayers are undead ghosts located in Eastern Plaguelands. They appear during The Battle of Darrowshire (quest).

Primary Weapons are the main weapon of usage. They include the following: *Assault Rifles (Cold War and Modern era) / Semi-Automatic Rifles (WWII era) *Submachine Guns *Shotguns (excluding Modern Warfare 2) *Support Weapons (WWII era) *Light Machine Guns (Cold War and Modern era) / Machine Guns (WWII era) *Sniper Rifles/Bolt-Action Rifles *Marksman Rifles *Tactical Rifles *Battle Rifles *Heavy Weapons (Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare) *Riot Shield, Assault Shield, Heavy Shield, MDL, M1 Irons, and Call of Duty: Ghosts version of the Combat Knife
Dawnbell is a faerie dragon located in the Ancient Bough in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

__NOTOC__ Death Flayer is a rare scorpid found roaming south of the Southfury Watershed in Durotar. He is on a 1.5 to 2.5 hour respawn timer. Death Flayer is the most vicious scorpid in all of Durotar. He uses his big toxic tail and stings the enemy, who'll collapse almost directly after. He was corrupted by the Demonic Warlocks from the Burning Blade clan when they came to Durotar. This scorpid lives around the rocks near the Southfury River and attacks anyone who gets near.
Dealer Rashaad is an ethereal small pet vendor located at the Stormspire in the Netherstorm.

The (or QBB-95, as called in the game files), is a bullpup light machine gun that appears in Call of Duty: Black Ops II, Call of Duty: Strike Team, Call of Duty: Mobile and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.
Deadwood Shaman are furbolgs found in Felpaw Village in Felwood.
Deadwind Warlocks are ogre magi found in the Vice in Deadwind Pass.

Death's Head Arachnomancer are located in Razorfen Downs. They will occasionally buff nearby spiders, increasing their attack speed by 100%. Arachnomancers grow giant spiders like thornweavers grow thorns. They are responsible for creating Aarux.

The Pulwar Sword is a melee weapon used in Call of Duty: Black Ops II campaign. It is related to many challenges that player can complete with it. It is found in several missions. It can only be used if the player is using the Access Kit. It has a longer reach than the knife, making it easier to slash enemies. The Pulwar can cause gibbing if aimed correctly when slashing, however sometimes the enemy may react as they did in Black Ops when losing an appendage, but they will be unharmed. The character can also decapitate enemies.

__NOTOC__ Dealer Vexil is a black dragonspawn located in a cave at the Smoldering Perch in the Waking Shores. After completing The Shadow of His Wings, or while under the Worldbreaker Membership, Vexil turns neutral and sells a few items.
Death Speaker Blackthorn is a quilboar found in the Spiral of Thorns in Razorfen Downs. He is capable of casting arcane magic.

Debbi Moore is a human trinket vendor found in Curiosities & Moore in Dalaran. During the purge of Dalaran, she was cowering in fear. When Dalaran moved above Karazhan, Debbi was seen casting a spell.

The Proteus Missile is a gadget that is featured in Call of Duty: Ghosts. It is used by Logan Walker in the mission Into the Deep to sink an enemy vessel. It launches a torpedo that is controlled via a targeting rig.
Deceased Thorignir are deceased storm drakes located in Stormheim. They were raised into undeath by the Knights of the Ebon Blade.
__NOTOC__ Deathspeaker Yutla is a Maw necromancer located in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Defias Blackguards are elite humans of the Defias Brotherhood found in the Deadmines. They were talented and high-ranked assassins of the Defias Brotherhood, who had been chosen to safeguard the head of the Brotherhood, Edwin VanCleef. They deceptively hid in stealth, staying unseen to the intruders, waiting for a perfect timing to assassinate those who would threaten the Brotherhood.
The Push Dagger is a melee weapon featured in Call of Duty: Ghosts, Call of Duty: WWII, Call of Duty: Vanguard and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.

Defias Mages are humans located in Northshire Valley in Elwynn Forest. Some are found accompanying Defias Ringleaders, Defias Rebels and Duncon Ratsbon. If brought low, the influence of the :Drakefire Amulet may wear off.
Defier Draghar is a red drakonid located in Ruby Life Pools.
Demolitions Experts are gnomes that take part in the Galakras encounter.
The Pytaek (referred to as the LSAT in the game files) is a heavy weapon in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare.

__NOTOC__ Denatharion is a night elf druid trainer located in the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. During the Burning of Teldrassil, he was caught in the chaos and could be saved. As of Dragonflight, he is seen floating around as a wisp at the Root-Bound Sanctuary in Amirdrassil, it is unknown what has happened to him.
Derrick Firebrand is a human located in Norwington Estate in Tiragarde Sound. He is summoning fireworks.

Deritetsin the Carver is a centaur spirit located in front of the Horn of Drusahl in the Ohn'ahran Plains. He is normally invisible and can only be seen while the player character is under the effect of Essence of Awakening. Gifting him a Horn o' Mead is required for Honor Our Ancestors.

The Quad Tank is a unit in Call of Duty: Heroes, added in update 2.1.0. The quad tank is capable of attacking more than one target at a time, occasionally firing two rockets. The unit is part of the Heavy Machine Facility. It occupies eighteen spaces. While powerful in itself, and helpful to players at command center 7, once a player reaches command center 8, they will often use the A.S.A.M. instead, due to its higher damage.
__NOTOC__ Desmond Chadsworth is a human flight master located at Victor's Point in the Twilight Highlands.

Devi is a high elf mage from an alternate universe and the apparent apprentice of , the alias of the great red dragon Korialstrasz. She is a dark-skinned elf with raven-black hair and has both a curious and inquisitive air about her that some within the Kirin Tor's ranks deem impudent. However, Krasus appreciates her up-front nature.
Devon Manning is a human flight master located at Light's Shield Tower in the Eastern Plaguelands.
The are a melee weapon featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops III, Call of Duty: Mobile, and Call of Duty: Black Ops 6.

Dink is a gnome mage trainer located in the Hall of Mysteries in the Mystic Ward in Ironforge. When Moira Thaurissan arrived to Ironforge, she had Dink and his sister Bink caught by Dark Iron guards but were released when Ironforge dwarves attacked them.

Sergeant Dimurov Grimear is an Ironforge dwarf fighter. He is a subcommander of the Ironforge city garrison. He is known for his strong leadership and military tactics. He keeps a determined command over his unit, his steel-hard will is an inspiration to his troops.

Dhambeela is a reclusive orc seer who sought solitude in a cave by the jungles of Un'Goro Crater. Kova was sent on a quest by Magatha Grimtotem to retrieve her. She is a personal friend and ally of Magatha whom she calls Mag. Dhambeela was found in a cave atop of Fire Plume Ridge. When they left the ridge, she was kidnapped by a human Bellthazor, but she overwhelmed him easily. When she returned to Thunder Bluff, she reunited with Magatha. It seems that she supported Magatha in killing Cairne.

The R3K is an energy burst-fire bullpup assault rifle in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. On September 7th, 2017, it received several updates. There had been a minor reduction in ADS time and sway, and also received lower burst delay, which all make the weapon more effective.

Dinah Halfmoon is a tauren quest giver located at the Mor'shan Rampart on the border of the Northern Barrens and Ashenvale. She can be found kneeling over the corpse of a fallen Horde soldier. Dinah is the daughter of a revered shaman, and is more powerful than she appears.
Ding'le is a pandaren monk of the Shado-Pan located at Thunder Totem in Highmountain, training some Highmountain Trainees.

A djinn is a type of powerful air elemental that can be found in Skywall. They made their first appearance during World of Warcraft: Cataclysm. It was the djinn that gave the tol'vir back their immortality as creatures of stone, in exchange for their allegiance to Deathwing. The only tribe of tol'vir to accept the offer were the Neferset. When the Orsis tribe refused to serve Deathwing, Al'Akir's djinn buried the city beneath a mighty sandstorm. Most djinn in World of Warcraft are powerful lieutenants of Al'Akir, though a minor one has also appeared trapped in the Magical Brazier inside the Vortex Pinnacle. A legend among the tol'vir tells of a wicked djinn whom the Ramkahen sought to destroy. In an attempt to prevent his own death, the djinn tried to transfer his spirit into the body of a monkey. He was slain right in the middle of the transference, and only a fraction of his essence had moved over - only enough to possess the monkey's paw. A fire elemental djinn has also been witnessed, leading a fire elemental assault on an :Azerite island.
The R.A.W. is an energy light machine gun featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare.

Doctor Kohler is the cultist responsible for raising The Black Knight into undeath after his defeat in The Black Knight's Fall. Players are directed to Kohler on his ledge at Deathspeaker's Watch during the quest The Black Knight's Fate, where they seek Doctor Kohler's Orders.

Doc Nanners is a marmoni located at the Dragonscale Basecamp in the Waking Shores. He chucks bananas at nearby players and NPCs. He also appears out in the world, as a messenger who offers Renown-related quests for the Dragonscale Expedition.
Dominic Arlington is a human flight master located at Zangarra in Talador.
The R-7 Skelter is a class of Skelter fighter jet capable of combat in air and in space in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare.

Dr. Boom is the former protégé of Lead Sapper Blastfizzle at Area 52. Previously known as Sparky Uberthruster, he refused to wear his protective nether helmet and over time became irradiated. He became known as Dr. Boom. He set up his camp northeast of Area 52 with a majority of the goblins' sapping equipment and has terrorized Area 52 ever since. Blastfizzle calls on adventurers of the Alliance and the Horde to destroy Dr. Boom and end his madness. Dr. Boom is a non-elite quest boss with 654,000 hitpoints; he does not move or use ranged attacks, making him a popular target for casters and Hunters to test their DPS output, as well as a target for leveling up ranged weapon skill. This fight is sort of a mini-game where you have to dodge his Bomblings to get close enough to throw the provided bombs at him, although it is possible to climb or fly over the rocks that surround him and kill him from behind. It is also possible to stand just beyond the range of the Bombling spawns and attack him that way, standing on the cart filled with explosives for instance.

__NOTOC__ Draenei Anchorite is a draenei priest that along with two Draenei Vindicators, is trying to cleanse the Pools of Aggonar of the corruption that inhabits it. Ryathen the Somber wants it stopped, as he doesn't want to lose his supply of felblood.

Dragon-Lord Neeralak is an orc keeping watch over the Blackrock clan's necromancers at Dreadmaul Rock while High Warlock Xi'lun is busy. His expertise is in dragons, however, not necromancy, a fact which his enemies try to use against him.

Primary Expert is a Loadout Option in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It allows an additional attachment on a player's primary weapon and can be equipped up to three times, allowing a maximum of five attachments and an optic. This option does not need to be selected separately from any additional attachments, but adding a third, fourth or fifth attachment costs 2 allocation points each. Each Primary Expert slot is unlocked separately, with slots being unlocked at levels 13, 27 and 39.

Dragonmaw Ascendants are drakonid found on Netherwing Ledge in Shadowmoon Valley. They are powerful fighters and should generally be avoided. According to Taskmaster Varkule Dragonbreath, the ascendants started out as peons.
Drahga Shadowburner is the third boss of the Grim Batol 5-player dungeon in World of Warcraft: Cataclysm. He's a member of the Twilight's Hammer.
Dread Auditor is an inquisitor located on the Dreadex in the Broken Shore. A stealth-detecting Auditor Eye flies in circles around him.

The R-16 Skelter is the upgraded version of the basic R-7 Skelter fighter used by the SDF's ace pilots. It's only appearance is in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. The R-16 is tougher than the base R-7. Ace pilots are also more maneuverable and will deploy flares much more often when fired at with missiles than R-7s. While all aces on the Most Wanted Board fly R-16s, not all R-16 aces are on the Board; Most Wanted aces will have their aircraft identified with their name, while non-Most Wanted aces will just be described as R-16 Skelters.
__NOTOC__ Dreadeye is a basilisk located in the Jagged Cove on the Broken Shore.
Drifthopper the Swift is a goat located in Island Expeditions.
Dreamguard Sayliasra is a wylderdrake located in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

The R-VN is a Fujiwara two-round auto-burst energy assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare that was added in the February 28th, 2017 update. It is a hybrid weapon, as the R-VN can also switch to a melee mode with instakill abilities, as well as an increased movement speed to catch up with other players. It is available for free for Season Pass holders, otherwise it can be unlocked via a challenge or a Supply Drop.

Prism Camouflage is a weapon camouflage featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered. It was added to the game on March 14th, 2017. Like with Folium Camouflage, it can only be unlocked by completing several challenges on the map Daybreak. The challenges include winning 25 matches (Assault Rifles), calling in 30 UAVs (Submachine Guns), flashing 50 enemies (Light Machine Guns), killing 50 enemies with frag grenades (Shotguns), killing 500 enemies overall (Sniper Rifles) or by killing 50 enemies with a melee weapon (Pistols). The camouflage appears as a light rainbow tinge upon the weapon, coupled with rain drops.
The Proteus is a sniper rifle that was added to Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare in the June 27th, 2017 update.
The Pride Weapon Kit is an Epic weapon kit available in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered.

Primed is an Epic gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It is exclusive to the Epic variants of the Auger, the Primed and Pumpkin Pummeler. Unlike its normal counterpart, the Auger variants fire at full speed without having to spool its barrel, but comes at the cost of a slightly slower fire rate.
The Proto-X1 (or Tokyo Arsenal 1927, as seen in the game files) is a submachine gun that was added in Call of Duty: WWII with the Shadow War update.
The Quad .50cal AA turret is a weapon mounting featured in Call of Duty 2: Big Red One.
Quad Shot is an Operator Mod exclusive to the GKS submachine gun. It converts it from full-auto to a four-round burst fire mode, allowing for better accuracy.
Primary Operator Mod is a Wildcard featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4. It allows the player to equip an Operator Mod for their Primary Weapon.

Quick is a weapon kit featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard available for all Submachine Guns, Shotguns, and Handguns. It increases the player’s sprint speed while using a weapon with this attachment equipped.

Quick Strike is a class featured in the Battle Royale mode of Call of Duty: Mobile. When using Quick Strike, the player will equip a Shadow Blade which they can use to deflect oncoming bullets from the front. The other option is for the player to lunge at the enemies and deliver a quick slash with the Shadow Blade to damage the enemies. The lunge animation will propel the player in the direction in which they are facing (i.e. if they are facing slightly up, then the animation will propel them up and in front). This can also be used to cross moderately long distances almost instantaneously.
Quick-Grip Gloves is a Glove featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III. When equipped with the Quick-Grip Gloves, the player has increased weapon swap speed.
The Pulse (Cyrillic: Імпульс) is a weapon manufacturer in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare.
Quarters Tactical Group, abbreviated as QTG, is a weapon manufacturer in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.

The PrismaTech Reflex is a reflex sight featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It is classed as a Universal Attachment and unlocking it for the weapon it is unlocked under, unlocks it for the entire weapon class. It is available for all weapon classes, excluding Pistols.

The R&K Multizoom is an optic featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It is classed as a Universal Attachment and unlocking it for the weapon it is unlocked under, unlocks it for the entire weapon class. It is available for most weapon classes, excluding Shotguns and Pistols.

The Pulse Rifle was an assault rifle that was featured in Call of Duty: Future Warfare. However, when Future Warfare was canceled, the Pulse Rifle was discarded as well, and was never ported to any other future titles.

The (called the Remington 700 in the game files and the official strategy guide) is a bolt-action sniper rifle that appears in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered and Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War. It can also be used in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, but only through console commands.

The is a light machine gun featured in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, Call of Duty: Black Ops (Nintendo DS), Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3: Defiance, Call of Duty: Black Ops II, Call of Duty Online, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered, Call of Duty: Mobile and Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War. It was cut from Call of Duty: Black Ops and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3. It serves as the main light machine gun used by the Russian forces.
RPG-7 x2 is a Tier 1 perk in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered, and as a purchasable weapon option in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3s Survival Mode.

in Call of Duty: World at War.]] Recoil is the movement of a weapon caused by firing the weapon. This movement causes the aim of subsequent shots to suffer unless the user pauses between shots to re-aim the weapon.

:For similarly named weapons, see R3K, RPD and PKM. The is a light machine gun featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops, Call of Duty: Black Ops: Declassified, Call of Duty: Black Ops III, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.
The RSASS is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that appears in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3.
Range is a Weapon Proficiency which appears in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3.

The RX4 Storm is a cut weapon from Call of Duty: Black Ops II. The menu selection image and HUD icon can be found in game files. They are named, menu_mp_weapons_rx4storm_big and menu_mp_weapons_rx4storm, respectively.
The is an air vehicle that makes a brief appearance in Call of Duty: Ghosts. It is only seen once, in the map Overlord.

The Razorback VTOL is a vehicle featured in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare, which is the main transport and gunship used primarily by the United States Marine Corps and the Sentinel Task Force in the main campaign. It appears to be the counterpart of the Atlas Corporation's Warbird. A Sentinel Razorback VTOL appears in the end cutscene for the Exo Zombies map Infection.

The RW1 is a pistol that appears in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. It is a single-shot weapon designed for medium-to-close range encounters; the weapon fires an electromagnetic slug at high velocity speeds, puncturing targets.
The , or the Arclight Railgun as it is known in the Campaign, is a mounted weapon in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare and a Defense card in Call of Duty: Siege.
The Razorback is a bullpup submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops III and Call of Duty: Mobile.

Ray Gun Only is a limited-time multiplayer game mode featured in Call of Duty Online. In this mode, the player only receives a Ray Gun the following perks Lightweight, Marathon, and Toughness. The game mode follows a Team Deathmatch style, with the first team to reach the score limit winning. In this game, the Ray Gun doesn't have an ammo counter, and instead will overheat if fired too much. Enemies killed will have their bodies instantly vaporized.
The RSA Interdiction is a bullpup bolt-action sniper rifle in Call of Duty: Black Ops III, added in the March 21, 2016 update and obtainable through supply drops.

Rearguard is a trait for the Phantom combat rig in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It appears as a small shield equipped to the player's back and able to absorb a small amount of damage from enemy fire, or melee attack, before it is destroyed. A new shield will protect the player when they re-spawn.

Reactive Armor is a payload for Merc in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare that is unlocked at level 21. When used, a protective shield forms around the player that decreases damage given to the player from all sources except for environmental damage, such as falling off the playable area of a map or the black hole of a Black Hole Projector. It also increases the player's health by 14 points while under the effects. A player is coated in a hexagonal patterned camouflage when under the effects of Reactive Armor. Reactive Armor is best utilized in a situation where the player needs to traverse a sniper sight line or while holding down the objective. It is ill-advised to use Reactive Armor when a player is breaching a defended position that contains multiple enemies, as Reactive Armor does not render the player invincible. The Reactive Armor duration was once nine seconds, but was decreased to seven seconds in the February 3rd, 2017 update. Within the same update, the amount of health with a Reactive Armor user has been decreased from 133 to 114.

The RPR Evo (originally known as the Ripper in pre-release, and still referred to as such in the game files) is a bullpup submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It uses the same features as the Ripper, which is the ability to transform the gun from a moderate fire-rate submachine gun to a slow fire-rate high damage assault rifle.

Readiness is a Common Gun Perk featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It allows the weapon to reload faster when the clip is nearly empty. It increases the low magazine reloading animation speed by 40%. It is the most useful on less ammo conservative weapons, allowing the user to eliminate enemies in between reloads with more reliability, or to quickly reload if the magazine were to become nearly exhausted after a firefight. It stacks with the faster reload time awarded with the perk Dexterity allowing even shorter reload times.
The Raven's Eye is a melee weapon in Call of Duty: Black Ops III, available in Supply Drops as of December 9th, 2016. It is highly reminiscent of ancient Chinese Deer Horn Knives or Duck Blades.

Reckless is an Epic gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It increases the fire rate of the weapon variant it is applied to, similar to the Rapid Fire attachment and the Double Tap perk of previous installments. It is exclusive to the RPR Evo - Ripper and Proteus - Polarity variants.

The Raijin-EMX is a three-round burst bullpup submachine gun added to Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare as part of the August 23rd, 2017 update, alongside the Atlas LMG. It features a unique integrated underbarrel Tactical EMP Launcher that fires a miniature EMP shot that explodes on impact. It has a high fire rate within the burst, but the burst delay of 200ms means that its rate of fire per minute is slower than average for SMGs, although the Raijin still shoots considerably fast.

The Rampart 17 (stylized RMPRT-17) is an assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4. It was developed in Germany by the fictional manufacturer Kühn & Schmidt. It also has an MKII variant along with a Mastercraft variant.

Reactive Camouflages are a style of weapon variants introduced in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4, originally as a form of Weapon Camouflage. Reactive Camouflages change appearance depending on actions that occur in-game. Reactive Camouflages are also available in Call of Duty: Mobile, Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War, Call of Duty: Vanguard, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III, Call of Duty: Black Ops 6, and Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 as a tier of Weapon Blueprint system.
The Reaver C86 is a special weapon featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4 and a Power-Up in Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War.

The , also referred to as the DP-12, is a shotgun featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Mobile. It is a high capacity weapon that can fire two barrels in a rapid succession before being pumped.
RAFINA Image & Precision is a weapon manufacturer in Call of Duty: Mobile.
RTC (Rinfuu Tactical Corporation) is a weapon manufacturer in Call of Duty: Mobile.

The (Reconnaissance Auxiliary Assault Lightweight Machine Gun) is a light machine gun featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III and Call of Duty: Mobile.
The Rally Car is a vehicle featured on Battle Royale mode in Call of Duty: Mobile. it was added in September 2021 as part of the Season 8: 2nd Anniversary update.

Reach is a Weapon Kit available in Call of Duty: Vanguard and Call of Duty: Warzone. It helps to increase the players' Melee range so they can hit a player who is a little farther ahead. This Kit is availabe for all Assault Rifles, Submachine Guns, Light Machine Guns, Marksman Rifles, Sniper Rifles and Handguns

The ROBOT GUN, or WEAPON_ROBOT_GUN, is a scrapped Assault Rifle that was planned to be featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops III. It can still be loaded in-game, however it's missing textures and proper animations. Nothing else is known about its planned inclusion.
The is a submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard. It was added as part of the Season Five update.
The Ray Gun Assembly Kit is a buildable featured in the Call of Duty: Black Ops 4 Zombies map, Alpha Omega. It can used to craft the elemental variants of the Ray Gun Mark II.
The is a bullpup submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III. It was added as part of the Season Two update.
Rattle Back, abbreviated as RB is a weapon manufacturer in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.
ROZ (rus. РОЗ) is a weapon manufacturer in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.

The Rampart Cannon is a utility featured in the Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 Zombies map, Citadelle des Morts. It is a transportation utility that when purchased for 500 Essence, will launch the player to Town Square.

Razor may refer to: *Razorback VTOL - A vehicle in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. *Razorback (submachine gun) - A submachine gun in Call of Duty: Black Ops III and Call of Duty: Mobile. *Razor Wire - A specialist equipment in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4. *Ethereal Razor - A Zombies Perk-a-Cola in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4. *Tempus Razorback - An assault rifle in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III. *Razor 1 Pilot - A character in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II. *Razorback (Modern Warfare III) - A tank in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III. *Slade "Razor" Barrick - A character in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 and Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0. *Razor 9mm - A submachine gun in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7. *Razor's Edge - A track in the Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 (Original Soundtrack). *Razor 9mm Wildfire Conversion - An attachment in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7. *Razor Wire Trap - A Field Upgrade in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4.
The Razor 9mm is a bullpup submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7.
The RK-9 is a submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7.
The REV-46 is a submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7. It was added as part of the Season Two update.
Red Tiger Camouflage is a weapon camouflage skin featured in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 , Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered, and Call of Duty: Black Ops 4.

Rifle Grenades can be equipped in Call of Duty 3, Call of Duty: World at War and Call of Duty: WWII. Like with the Grenade Launcher, it is not possible to aim down the sights whilst using the Rifle Grenade. It is also used via a gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare.
Brigadier General Richter, known by the alias of "Black Baron", was an ace German tank commander in Call of Duty 3.
Red Camouflage is a weapon camouflage skin featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 and Call of Duty: Ghosts.

Redemption is the fifteenth and final mission of Call of Duty: Black Ops. It is set upon a Russian ship, the Rusalka, and has Mason and Hudson attempting to stop Nova 6 from being unleashed in the USA.
Reich Camouflage was a Weapon Camouflage skin planned to appear in Call of Duty: World at War, but was cut from the final version of the game.
Rhino 2 was the callsign of an M1A2 Abrams tank in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3.
Rhino 1 is the call sign of an American M1A2 Abrams tank operated by the U.S. Army in the mission Goalpost during the events of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3.
Rhino 3 was the callsign of an M1A2 Abrams tank belonging to the U.S. Army in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3.
The Remington R5 RGP is an assault rifle that appears in Call of Duty: Ghosts, Call of Duty Online and Call of Duty: Heroes.

Restricted Airspace is an achievement/trophy in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. It requires the player to EMP 10 enemy aircraft out of the sky with the hovertank in "Bio Lab". Restricted Airspace XBOX One Achievement Image CoDAW.jpg|XBOX One Achievement Image

The Repulsor is a piece of tactical equipment featured in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare in the Exo Zombies maps Carrier and Descent and in the Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare Zombies maps Zombies in Spaceland and Rave in the Redwoods.
Repulsor Armor is a tactical rig in Call of Duty: Black Ops III. The rig repels enemy grenades outside of the player's radius. When upgraded, it can also repel rockets.
The is a weapon attachment in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It increases weapon damage range by 20%, or by 10% for shotguns. On energy weapons, the equivalent attachment is the Particle Amp.
Regal Camouflage is a type of weapon camouflage skin featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered.

The Retractable Shield is a tactical equipment only available in the campaign of Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. The shield is obtained in Operation Port Armor, where it is dropped by an R-C8. After being picked up, it can be equipped as a tactical in the player's loadout.

Refresher is a Legendary gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare, found upon certain weapon variants. It returns a single tactical and lethal equipment to the player when they kill 5 enemy players without dying. In Zombies mode, you need to kill 50 zombies with the weapon.

Refund is a Rare gun perk that appears in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare, found upon certain weapon variants. It returns any missed shots into the player's reserve ammunition counter for the weapon variant it is applied to.
The is a Scorestreak featured in Call of Duty: WWII. Recon Aircraft reveals the enemies position on the mini-map. It works similarly to UAV and Spy Plane from previous games.
The attachment is exclusive to the M30 Luftwaffe Drilling in Call of Duty: WWII. It allows the player to use the third rifle barrel of the M30 Luftwaffe Drilling.
The Red Talon is a sword melee weapon and is a easter egg available in the Zombies mode of Call of Duty: WWII.

The Ribeyrolles is a submachine gun that was added to Call of Duty: WWII with the Days of Summer event. It features a round half moon magazine which the bullets can be visually seen and are expended while firing.
The Repeater is an Operator Mod featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4. It is only available for the ABR 223 and allows the weapon to continuously fire bursts while holding down the trigger.
Reyland Outdoors is a weapon manufacturer in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare.

Refitter is a class featured in the Battle Royale mode of Call of Duty: Mobile. Refitter will allow players to drop armor packs for themselves and teammates. This armor will stack on top of the armor plates that they use, and can be replenished by re-deploying the class. A total of 3 armor packs can be used at a given time. In addition to providing faster health recovery time for the player and reviving teammates who have been knocked down, the Refitter class will also automatically repair the vehicle the player is riding if it had sustained damage prior.

The Redwell Reflex is a reflex sight featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It is classed as a Universal Attachment and unlocking it for the weapon it is unlocked under, unlocks it for the entire weapon class. It is available for Assault Rifles, SMGs, Marksman Rifles and Sniper Rifles.

The Remuda Mini Reflex is a reflex sight featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It is classed as a Universal Attachment and unlocking it for the weapon it is unlocked under, unlocks it for the entire weapon class. It is available for Assault Rifles, SMGs, Shotguns and Pistols.

The Remuda Range Finder is an optic featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It is classed as a Universal Attachment and unlocking it for the weapon it is unlocked under, unlocks it for the entire weapon class. It is available for LMGs, Marksman Rifles and Sniper Rifles.

The Redwell Custom Zoom is an optic featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It is classed as a Universal Attachment and unlocking it for the weapon it is unlocked under, unlocks it for the entire weapon class. It is available for LMGs, Marksman Rifles and Sniper Rifles.

The Remuda Dual Zoom is an optic featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It is classed as a Universal Attachment and unlocking it for the weapon it is unlocked under, unlocks it for the entire weapon class. It is available for Marksman Rifles and Sniper Rifles.
The Recovery Plate Carrier is an equipment featured in Call of Duty: Mobile. It was added in February 2026's Season 2: Lunar Charge update, and is available in Battle Royale as a plate carrier.

A Rifle is a type of firearm that used for mid to long range distances, mainly covering semi-automatic, bolt-action and fully automatic infantry rifles used in combat. '"Rifle" may refer to: *Sniper Rifle - A type of firearm designed for long-range shooting. *Semi-Automatic rifle - A type of firearm designed for between long and mid-range shooting *Automatic Rifle - A type of self-loading rifle that is capable of fully automatic fire. *Assault Rifle - A type of firearm designed for mid-range shooting. *Marksman Rifle - A type of firearm designed for mid to long-range shooting. *Tactical Rifle - A type of firearm for mid to long-range shooting (similar to the marksman rifle). *Rifle Grenade - A World War II-era rifle-mounted grenade. *APS Underwater Rifle - An assault rifle designed for underwater combat. *13th Guards Rifle Division - A Red Army infantry division. *62nd Rifle Division - A Red Army infantry division. *150th Rifle Division - A Red Army infantry division.

Red can refer to: *Red Camouflage - A Weapon Camouflage in Call of Duty: Black Ops, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 and Call of Duty: Ghosts. *Red Tiger Camouflage - A Weapon Camouflage in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2. *Ronald "Red" Daniels - The main protagonist in Call of Duty: WWII.

Remington can refer to: *R700 - A sniper rifle in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War (referred to as Remington 700 in the game files). *Remington A.C.R. - The ACR as it is called in Call of Duty Online. *Remington MSR - A sniper rifle in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 and Call of Duty Online. *Remington 870 - A shotgun in Call of Duty: Black Ops (Nintendo DS) and Call of Duty Online. *Remington 870 MCS - The variant in Call of Duty: Black Ops II, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III. *Remington New Model Army - A revolver in Call of Duty: Black Ops II. *Remington R5 - An assault rifle in Call of Duty: Ghosts and Call of Duty Online. The Remington logo can also be seen on the side of some weapons: *ACR 6.8 - A rifle in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III. *RSASS - A sniper rifle in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3.
Road to Remagen is the 17th level in Call of Duty: Finest Hour. The player plays as Chuck Walker as he and his squadmates, including Benny Church, secure Remagen.

Ring of Steel is the ninth level in Call of Duty: World at War. It continues from the ending of the previous level, Blood and Iron in which a train full of Soviet troops assault the surrounding area of suburbs and outskirts of Berlin.

Boatswain's Mate First Class Rojas was a sailor in the United States Navy. On the level "Black Cats", his ship was hit during a Kamikaze attack while his fleet was en route to Okinawa. Machine-gunner Petty Officer Locke saves him when his PBY Catalina floats by. Rojas tried to climb aboard, but couldn't do it on his own. River Raiders is the eleventh level of Call of Duty: Black Ops (Nintendo DS), where the player must man a machine gun on a boat and fight enemy ground and river forces. Then the player must fight to the extraction zone on foot.
Riot Shield Squad is an air support option available in the Survival Mode in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3.
The Rising Sun Camouflage was a weapon camouflage skin planned to appear in Call of Duty: World at War, but was cut from the final version of the game.
Royal Camouflage was a Weapon Camouflage planned to appear in Call of Duty: World at War, and is a Common camouflage in Call of Duty: Black Ops III.

The S12 (Saiga-12) is a weapon appearing as a semi-automatic shotgun in Call of Duty: Black Ops II and Call of Duty Online, and as a fully-automatic shotgun in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered.
The Ronin Camouflage is a weapon camouflage skin available in Call of Duty: Black Ops II. This Camouflage can only be unlocked after the Kryptek: Typhon Camouflage has been unlocked.
